result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers over-edit a map that only needed light touches. A at least calls the core story strong, keeps its changes mostly as notes on the slides and gives a clear board ask (put the card policy up front as the decision). B is much longer, adds new frames, moment markers and status blocks, and turns the observed 5 parents into an invented '5 of 5'. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers suggest far more than the light touch the rubric asks for, but A goes further. It adds a status line, a three-line frame, marked moments, measures for each fix and a paste-ready block. It also turns the observation of 5 parents into '5 of 5,' a count the page doesn't support. B is shorter, flags the real gap that the page never says how many arrivals the 5 came from, and gives the most useful advice for the meeting itself: put the decision you want from the board up front, and make the card policy the ask.
